description: Submit a review agent's eval. Record one review agent's result on one push of a change: a `value` (0–100 for a score agent, 1/0 for a boolean one), a short `rationale`, and any `findings`. The verdict (pass / warn / fail) is computed from the agent's threshold and polarity. Submitting again for the same pu…

agent.description: Your agent type, when you are the review agent.

agentKey.description: The review agent's key (from `ops review-agents list`).

findings.description: Issues to fix, each with a severity, and a file and line when there is one.

severity.description: How much a finding matters. The Agent review gate blocks on open findings at or above its configured severity.

handle.description: The trail's handle (`T-12`) or its id.

headSha.description: The commit reviewed. Omitted, the change's latest push. A sha that is not the latest push is recorded against that push, as history.

prUrl.description: The change reviewed. Omitted, the trail's primary change.

rationale.description: One or two sentences on the evidence behind the value.

resources.description: Product resources the reviewed diff uses (`getFlag("x")`, `getExperiment("y")`, `t("key")`). They are linked to the trail as detected. A key that does not exist yet becomes a finding.

items.description: A resource to link to a trail. When `role` is omitted it is guessed from the kind: a gate ships behind, a kill switch is the rollback, an experiment measures, an alert rule guards, an i18n key is copy, anything else is touched.

kind.description: The product entities a trail can ship or depend on. `gate` is a feature flag.

resourceKey.description: The entity's key (a gate or metric name, an experiment name, an i18n key). Resolved to the entity when it exists.

role.description: What a resource is for on the trail — `ships_behind` (the flag the code ships behind), `rollback` (the kill switch that undoes it), `measures` (the experiment or metric that judges it), `guards` (an alert rule that watches it), `copy` (an i18n key it adds) or `touched` (anything else). The release gates and the release phase read these.

sessionId.description: Your session id, so the eval can deep-link to the review run.

value.description: 0–100 for a score agent; 1 (yes) or 0 (no) for a boolean one.

name: trails_submit_eval
